title: Aromatic Egyptian Pak Choi Stew
description: A herbaceous, tender stew that blends the crispness of pak choi with a warm Egyptian spice blend, finished with lemon for brightness.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for 1 minute more.
Add the tomato paste, cumin, coriander, and smoked paprika, cooking until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add the drained chickpeas and let the stew simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the pak choi leaves and stems, folding them into the broth, and simmer until the pak choi is tender, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, then stir in the lemon juice.
Remove the pot from heat and sprinkle chopped parsley over the top.
Serve hot, optionally with a side of crusty bread or rice.
